description: This file defines an Android activity called PackageBrowser, which displays a list of installed packages on the device, allows deletion of packages, and handles package addition/removal broadcasts. It manages package information displays and interactions within the Android application context.

classes.name: PackageBrowser
classes.description: Main activity that manages and displays installed packages, handles package deletion and listens for package-related broadcasts.

classes.name: MyPackageInfo
classes.description: Data class holding PackageInfo and a human-readable label for each package.

classes.name: PackageListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class that populates list items with package icon, name, and package name.

classes.name: ApplicationsIntentReceiver
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that listens for package add/remove/change intents to update the package list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up list adapter, and registers receivers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receiver upon activity destruction.

methods.name: setupAdapter
methods.description: Creates and sets the PackageListAdapter for the ListView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with delete package action.

methods.name: deletePackage
methods.description: Initiates package deletion process with user confirmation and handles callback.

methods.name: registerIntentReceivers
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for package add/remove/change events.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to navigate to package details.
